title: COFFEE: Counterfactual Fairness for Personalized Text Generation in Explainable Recommendation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating counterfactual fairness by swapping the user's gender attribute token and measuring the resulting disparity in the linguistic quality (specifically Feature Coverage, informativeness, detailedness, and helpfulness) of the generated recommendation explanations.

Evaluating counterfactual fairness on the item side by altering a restaurant's price range attribute ($, $$, $$$) and measuring the disparity in the linguistic quality (Feature Coverage) of the generated explanations.
